benefits.name: Ability Score Increase
benefits.summary: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma, max 20.

benefits.name: Concentration
benefits.summary: Advantage on CON saves to keep Concentration.

benefits.name: Reactive Spell
benefits.summary: When a creature provokes an Opportunity Attack by leaving your reach, Reaction: cast a 1-action spell targeting only it instead of attacking.

benefits.name: Somatic Components
benefits.summary: Do Somatic components with weapons or a Shield in your hands.

summary: Cast reliably in the thick of melee.

name: Warlike Familiar

benefits.name: Ability Score Increase
benefits.summary: +1 to any ability, max 20.

benefits.name: Battle Familiar
benefits.summary: Battle Familiar always prepared; free once per Long Rest, or cast with your slots. Uses your Familiar Friend ability.

benefits.name: Intercept Attack
benefits.summary: When an attack roll hits a creature within 5 ft of your familiar, the familiar's Reaction adds your PB to that creature's AC against it, which may turn it into a miss.

summary: Turn your familiar into a fighter that guards those beside it.

name: Watchers

benefits.name: Borrowed Eyes
benefits.summary: Beast Sense and Speak with Animals are always prepared; each is castable once per Long Rest without a slot, or with slots.

benefits.name: Heightened Suspicion
benefits.summary: Add 1d4 to checks made with the Search action.

benefits.name: Incessant Watchers
benefits.summary: Disadvantage on saves against Scrying. Right after a natural 1 on a D20 Test, WIS save (DC 13 + PB) or suffer Disadvantage on all D20 Tests for up to 1 minute (save again after each turn you take to end it).

summary: Vermin and eerie creatures keep watch for you, and the feeling of being watched never leaves.

name: Weapon Master

benefits.name: Ability Score Increase
benefits.summary: +1 Strength or Dexterity, max 20.

benefits.name: Mastery Property
benefits.summary: Use the mastery property of one Simple or Martial weapon kind you are proficient with; swap the kind after a Long Rest.

summary: Use one weapon kind’s mastery property.

name: Will to Survive

prerequisite.text: World of Warcraft Campaign, Human Species
prerequisite.feature: World of Warcraft Campaign, Human Species

summary: Stormwind or Stromgarde grit: on your turn, ignore Incapacitated (unless you're also Unconscious) by taking 1 Exhaustion level.

name: Ysgardian Warrior

benefits.name: Ability Score Increase
benefits.summary: +1 Strength, Dexterity or Constitution, max 20.

benefits.name: Ysgardian Spirit
benefits.summary: On becoming Bloodied, your next attack roll before your next turn ends has Advantage, and a hit adds PB damage of the attack's type. Once per Short or Long Rest.

summary: A warrior of Ysgard who hits back hardest when hurt.

name: Zhentarim Ruffian

benefits.name: Exploit Opening
benefits.summary: Opportunity Attack damage: roll the dice twice and pick either result.

benefits.name: Family First
benefits.summary: Spend Heroic Inspiration when you roll Initiative to give you and your allies Advantage on it.

summary: Mercenary tricks: punishing Opportunity Attacks and a family head start.

name: Zhentarim Tactics

benefits.name: Ability Score Increase
benefits.summary: +1 Dexterity or Charisma, max 20.

benefits.name: Retaliate
benefits.summary: Right after a creature within 5 ft hits you in melee, make an Opportunity Attack against it.

benefits.name: Versatile Merc
benefits.summary: After each Long Rest, gain Expertise in one skill you’re proficient in until the next Long Rest.

summary: Mercenary instincts: hit back in melee and pick up a skill for the day.
